bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
row="$(docker exec -i deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F ' ' <<'SQL'
SELECT t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id FROM announcement_posts a JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id AND d.status='sent' JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id AND t.purpose='announcement' AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.verified_at IS NOT NULL WHERE a.kind='recruitment' AND a.room_id IS NULL AND a.status='sync_error' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL;
SQL
)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$row" | wc -l)" = 1
read -r chat mid extra <<< "$row"
test -z "$extra"
test -n "$chat" && test -n "$mid"
python=deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python
"$python" -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
# This existing exact-message probe checks only presence and Bot ownership in the three registered boards.
# Do not treat the ROOM marker as evidence of recruitment format.
"$python" -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$mid"
